title: Document and Records Control | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Business operations

Control the document lifecycle without losing the operating context.

BOF organizes document intake, naming, version, required fields, review requests, approval state, retention context, owner, and the work affected by the record.

Book a workflow review →

Source record

Source document, record type, related driver, carrier, asset, load, customer, policy, version, dates, and required fields.

Review path

The record is checked for identity, legibility, completeness, date, current version, relation to the work, and unresolved requests.

Decision-ready output

A controlled record with review state, current version, evidence reference, owner, exception, and next use.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

An expired, missing, damaged, mismatched, or superseded record stays attached to the decision it affects.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Source document, record type, related driver, carrier, asset, load, customer, policy, version, dates, and required fields.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The record is checked for identity, legibility, completeness, date, current version, relation to the work, and unresolved requests.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A controlled record with review state, current version, evidence reference, owner, exception, and next use. An expired, missing, damaged, mismatched, or superseded record stays attached to the decision it affects.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF supports records administration; retention schedules, legal holds, professional determinations, and system-of-record authority remain with the fleet.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • A working session qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
